crossRefs.note: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out…

translations.web: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
translations.bsb: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it with the same eager desire, according to your means.
translations.kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
translations.asv: But now complete the doing also; that as there was the readiness to will, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
